description: Verdict signal rules for Fib + ZOI swing trade analysis. Verdicts: STRONG BUY, BUY, WATCH, WAIT, SKIP, AVOID, CAUTION. v4: fibZoiCombined keyed on fibClass + zoiPosition (16 states) + pocketVsZone geometry (OVERLAP / POCKET_ABOVE / POCKET_BELOW / N/A). v5: patternModifiers layer — candlestick + chart patterns modify the fib/zoi base verdict (upgrade a BUY to STRONG BUY via the confluence tier, or demote a BUY to CAUTION on a hard bearish confirmation). See docs/*-verdict-scenarios.md (CF/PF/CZ/PZ/CFZ/PFZ/PCF/PCZ/PCFZ).

STRONG BUY.meaning: A-grade confluence — a fib/zoi BUY additionally backed by a confirmed bullish chart pattern and/or a Tier-1 bullish reversal candle

BUY.meaning: Valid entry — confirmed setup, take the trade

WAIT.meaning: Not actionable yet — price needs to reach a zone or confirm direction

SKIP.meaning: No valid entry — missed the move or not deep enough

AVOID.meaning: Actively dangerous — high risk of loss if you enter here

CAUTION.meaning: Conflicting signals — a bearish pattern fired at the entry; stand aside / wait for clarity

patternModifiers.disabledNote: DISABLED 2026-06-05 by request: the verdict must be PURELY mode-driven geometry (FIB = only fib rules, ZOI = only zone rules, FIB+ZOI = the combined rules). Candle/chart patterns are an EXTERNAL factor and must not sway a fib/zoi-only call. They will be re-enabled only after data/verdict-rules.json is expanded with explicit candle x fib, chart x fib, candle x zoi, chart x zoi (and combined) rows so the pattern impact is encoded per-mode rather than as a blanket BUY->CAUTION / BUY->STRONG BUY override. While disabled, _applyPatternModifiers early-returns (enabled === false) so no demote, no STRONG-BUY promote, and no pattern confluence bonus is applied; the chart still DRAWS detected patterns (visual only).
patternModifiers.description: Candlestick + geometric chart patterns are layered ON TOP of the fib/zoi base verdict (the source-of-truth scenarios live in docs/candle-fib-..., chart-fib-..., candle-zoi-..., chart-zoi-..., candle-fib-zoi-..., chart-fib-zoi-..., chart-candle-fib-..., chart-candle-zoi-..., chart-candle-fib-zoi-verdict-scenarios.md). PRECEDENCE: patterns can UPGRADE a BUY's conviction (→ STRONG BUY, via the existing confluence A+/A/B tier) or DEMOTE a BUY to CAUTION on a HARD bearish confirmation — but they NEVER upgrade a non-BUY (WAIT/WATCH/AVOID/SKIP) into a BUY. Location + structure must already allow the long (false-positive guard, per .cursor/rules/trading-context.mdc). Hard location vetoes (supply / broken-demand / swing-high) are already AVOID in fibOnly/zoiOnly/fibZoiCombined, so this layer only adds the pattern trigger/structure dimension.
